Long, wavy, bubblegum pink hair with blunt bangs and a small side ponytail. Large, innocent, shimmering amethyst eyes. Apparent age of a late teenager with a youthful, soft face. Slender, petite build. A white and gold sleeveless tunic with a short pleated skirt and brown leather boots. A small, matching pink bow tied at the back of the head.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
